comment: Which agent skills a generated project receives, keyed by tag.
A generated project carries tags of two types. It has exactly one project
type ('<language>:<product>', which decides its build system and its
starting files) and any number of capabilities (a library or framework on
top). A project receives the 'global' list, its project type's list, and
the list of every capability it declares.
The tags themselves are defined in templates/: each
templates/project-types/<slug>/project-type.json and
templates/capabilities/<slug>/capability.json declares its key, what it
is, and for a capability which project types or languages it fits and
which capabilities it excludes. This file only says which skills each tag
brings, and cli/tests/skills_manifest_test.rs checks the two agree.
Every entry is a source spec handed to `npx skills add` verbatim, so it
must resolve to exactly one skill: 'owner/repo' when the repository's
SKILL.md is at its root, 'owner/repo/path/to/skill' otherwise.
This file has nothing to do with skills-lock.json. The lock records the
skills installed in THIS repository for working on quickstarter itself;
`npx skills add` or `npx skills remove` here changes nothing about the
repositories quickstarter produces.
pbakaus/impeccable is the one entry the scaffolder does not hand to
`npx skills`, because impeccable ships its own installer. See the skills
section of docs/scaffolder.md.
